bugs.signature: unsafe impl<'a, R: RawMutex + 'a, T: ?Sized + 'a> Send for MappedMutexGuard<'a, R, T>
bugs.rationale: RUSTSEC-2020-0070 / CVE-2020-35910: MappedMutexGuard's Send impl uses only `R::GuardMarker: Send` but ignores whether T itself is Send/Sync. The mapped projection can therefore send a reference to non-Sync data across threads while the underlying lock guard is still live -- breaks the `lock_api` exclusion invariant. Fixed in 0.4.2.

bugs.signature: unsafe impl<'a, R: RawRwLock + 'a, T: ?Sized + 'a> Send for MappedRwLockReadGuard<'a, R, T>
bugs.rationale: RUSTSEC-2020-0070 / CVE-2020-35910: MappedRwLockReadGuard's Send impl uses only `R::GuardMarker: Send` but ignores whether T itself is Send/Sync. Read projection can send a `&T` to a thread where T's interior mutability invariants do not hold -- same missing_lock soundness hole as the mutex case. Fixed in 0.4.2.

bugs.signature: unsafe impl<'a, R: RawRwLock + 'a, T: ?Sized + 'a> Send for MappedRwLockWriteGuard<'a, R, T>
bugs.rationale: RUSTSEC-2020-0070 / CVE-2020-35910: MappedRwLockWriteGuard's Send impl uses only `R::GuardMarker: Send` but ignores whether T itself is Send/Sync. Write projection can send `&mut T` to a thread that cannot legally hold the writer's exclusive borrow -- third site of the same missing_lock pattern. Fixed in 0.4.2.
